AI.name: Anthropic Research
AI.expected_value: high — frontier agent research, safety, HAI papers
AI.notes: Primary source for agent architecture, Claude capabilities, AI safety. Directly relevant to growth edge ge-02.

AI.name: OpenAI Research
AI.expected_value: high — GPT/multimodal model releases, technical reports
AI.notes: Model releases and technical deep-dives. Complements Anthropic for full picture of frontier AI.

AI.name: Google DeepMind Blog
AI.expected_value: high — AlphaFold, Gemini, neuroscience × AI intersection
AI.notes: Unique position at AI × Neuroscience. Valuable for cognitive science connections.

AI.name: arXiv AI (cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.LG)
AI.expected_value: very_high — preprint server, raw research, no paywall
AI.notes: THE primary signal source. Use with keyword filters to avoid noise. Focus on: agents, multimodal, HCI-AI, reasoning.

AI.name: Hugging Face Papers
AI.expected_value: high — trending ML papers with community engagement metrics
AI.notes: Good for discovering what's getting practical traction. Papers with Code links are BUILD signals.

AI.name: Papers With Code
AI.notes: Useful when a NOW signal references a benchmark. Provides implementation context.

Data_Science.name: MIT OpenCourseWare — Mathematics for Computer Science
Data_Science.expected_value: high — foundational math for DS, free, structured
Data_Science.notes: Directly addresses growth edge ge-01 (DS foundations). Reference for LEARN recommendations.

Data_Science.name: StatQuest with Josh Starmer
Data_Science.expected_value: high — intuitive explanations of stats/ML concepts
Data_Science.notes: Best visual explanation of statistical concepts on the internet. Perfect for DS foundation building.

Data_Science.name: arXiv Statistics (stat.ML, stat.CO)
Data_Science.notes: Complement to arXiv AI. Focus on methods that connect theory to practice.

Data_Science.name: ThreeBlueOneBrown
Data_Science.expected_value: very_high — visual intuition for mathematical concepts
Data_Science.notes: Exceptional for building mathematical intuition. Neural networks series is essential viewing.

Psychology_Cognitive_Science.name: Nature Human Behaviour
Psychology_Cognitive_Science.expected_value: very_high — top-tier journal at psychology × behavior × technology intersection
Psychology_Cognitive_Science.notes: Single most important psych/cogsci source. Covers cognition, decision-making, tech impact on behavior.

Psychology_Cognitive_Science.name: Psychological Science
Psychology_Cognitive_Science.expected_value: high — premier journal for experimental psychology
Psychology_Cognitive_Science.notes: Stronger on pure experimental psych than Nature HB. Good for cognitive load, memory, attention research.

Psychology_Cognitive_Science.name: APA PsycNet (selected open access)
Psychology_Cognitive_Science.notes: Use via Ca' Foscari library access. Primary literature database for psychology.

Psychology_Cognitive_Science.name: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Cognitive Science
Psychology_Cognitive_Science.notes: Excellent for LEARN signals that need conceptual clarity before diving into papers.

HCI_Interaction_Design.name: ACM CHI Conference Proceedings
HCI_Interaction_Design.expected_value: very_high — premier HCI conference, defines the field's direction
HCI_Interaction_Design.notes: Core HCI source. Best papers define what matters in HCI each year. Essential for career direction.

HCI_Interaction_Design.name: ACM TOCHI (Transactions on Computer-Human Interaction)
HCI_Interaction_Design.expected_value: high — deepest HCI research, long-form papers
HCI_Interaction_Design.notes: More theoretical than CHI. Good for understanding HCI foundations, not just latest trends.

HCI_Interaction_Design.name: Nielsen Norman Group (NN/g)
HCI_Interaction_Design.expected_value: high — UX research made practical, evidence-based
HCI_Interaction_Design.notes: Bridges academic HCI and practice. Articles on usability, information architecture, interaction patterns.

HCI_Interaction_Design.name: Interactions Magazine (ACM)
HCI_Interaction_Design.expected_value: high — accessible HCI/design commentary + case studies
HCI_Interaction_Design.notes: More readable than CHI proceedings. Good for SEE signals — design case studies with analysis.

Design_Typography_Visual.name: AIGA Eye on Design
Design_Typography_Visual.expected_value: high — design criticism, process documentation, industry direction
Design_Typography_Visual.notes: Top-tier design publication. Not just pretty pictures — real design thinking and criticism.

Design_Typography_Visual.name: It's Nice That
Design_Typography_Visual.expected_value: high — daily creative work showcase with brief context
Design_Typography_Visual.notes: Good for SEE signals — discover new work, note techniques. Keep it quick — don't deep-dive every post.

Design_Typography_Visual.name: Information Is Beautiful
Design_Typography_Visual.expected_value: high — dataviz best practices demonstrated, not just theorized
Design_Typography_Visual.notes: David McCandless's work. Each visualization is a mini-case study in information design.

Design_Typography_Visual.name: Typographica (Oliver Reichenstein)
Design_Typography_Visual.expected_value: very_high — deepest typography thinking on the web
Design_Typography_Visual.notes: iA founder. Essential reading for typography as information architecture, not decoration.

Design_Typography_Visual.name: Design Principles Index (InVision/now archived)
Design_Typography_Visual.expected_value: medium — searchable collection of design principles with examples
Design_Typography_Visual.notes: Quick reference for design pattern discovery. Use when a SEE signal references an unfamiliar principle.

Data_Visualization.name: Pudding.cool / Pudding
Data_Visualization.expected_value: very_high — visual essays that push dataviz boundaries
Data_Visualization.notes: Gold standard for creative data visualization. Every piece is a SEE signal candidate. Process often documented.

Data_Visualization.name: Data Visualization Society
Data_Visualization.notes: WeekUp newsletter is good signal source. Community discussions surface trends early.

Data_Visualization.name: The Functional Art (Alberto Cairo)
Data_Visualization.expected_value: very_high — dataviz philosophy: truthful, functional, beautiful, insightful
Data_Visualization.notes: Cairo's framework (truthful/functional/beautiful/insightful) is the right mental model for dataviz evaluation.

Data_Visualization.name: Observable
Data_Visualization.expected_value: high — live notebooks showing dataviz/code in action
Data_Visualization.notes: Good for BUILD signals — find reusable approaches. Also SEE for technique discovery.

Culture_Cultural_Heritage.name: Europeana
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.expected_value: very_high — Europe's digital cultural heritage platform, millions of items
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.notes: Living in Europe = direct access. Potential data source for DH projects. Blog covers digital preservation news.

Culture_Cultural_Heritage.name: UNESCO Culture Sector
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.expected_value: high — global policy, conventions, heritage protection frameworks
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.notes: Policy-level view of cultural heritage. Useful for understanding the institutional landscape around preservation.

Culture_Cultural_Heritage.name: Digital Humanities Quarterly
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.expected_value: very_high — premier DH journal, peer-reviewed, open access
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.notes: Where DH research happens. Essential for understanding current state of the field and finding research directions.

Culture_Cultural_Heritage.name: Programming Historian
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.expected_value: very_high — peer-reviewed technical lessons for humanists learning to code
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.notes: Perfect entry point into DH. Lessons are practical, code-based, and cover real research workflows.

Culture_Cultural_Heritage.name: Venice Musei Civici
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.expected_value: high — Venice civic museums network, local exhibitions and collections
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.notes: Local Venice resource. Exhibitions, events, digitization projects. Physical access available.

Culture_Cultural_Heritage.name: Stanford Digital Humanities Resources
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.expected_value: high — curated tools, methods, project directory from leading DH center
Culture_Cultural_Heritage.notes: Good overview of DH ecosystem. Useful for discovering methods and potential collaborators.

Knowledge_Systems.name: Building a Second Brain (Tiago Forte)
Knowledge_Systems.expected_value: medium-high — CODE method for personal knowledge management
Knowledge_Systems.notes: Relevant to your Anki system and knowledge organization habits. The PKM framework, not the hype.

Knowledge_Systems.name: Andy Matuschak's Notes
Knowledge_Systems.expected_value: very_high — original thinking on memory, learning systems, augmented cognition
Knowledge_Systems.notes: Orbit project, spaced repetition research, notes-as-thinking-tool. Directly connects Knowledge Systems × CogSci × HCI.

curation_principles: Every source must have a clear justification for inclusion
No two sources should serve identical purpose (deduplication by function, not URL)
Authority level reflects trustworthiness of content, not popularity
European sources prioritized where equivalent quality exists (user is in Venice)
Open-access or free tier preferred; paid sources noted but included only if uniquely valuable
meta.maintenance_schedule: Review quarterly; add/remove based on signal quality over time
